This summary covers the period from 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-23, encompassing the last seven days of ROBI’s operation. During this time, ROBI processed a total of 136 orders, with 71 successfully delivered, 6 delivered with warnings, and 59 orders that failed. The average fetch time was 93 seconds, while the median fetch time was 67 seconds, reflecting the variety of items ROBI was tasked with retrieving. 

Notably, ROBI experienced a high number of failures this week, with 9 [[reachability]]_failed events, 1 [[no-valid-depth]] event, and 55 [[arm-fault]]s. A single order, #321 for the water bottle, took an exceptionally long 2875 seconds to complete, requiring 9 retries. Across all orders, there were a total of 15 retries, and 44 collision warnings were recorded, indicating potential areas for further investigation regarding ROBI’s movement patterns.
